_what: Every entry on which a fresh reader's code differs from the practice's, classified by the practice AFTER reading the readers' own 'held' and 'judged' labels (readers/reader-A.json, reader-B.json). Post hoc; not in PREDICTIONS.md.

_classes.swap: the reader and the practice name the same thing as wrong, and put it on opposite sides (the practice's held term is the reader's judged term, or the reverse)
_classes.partial: one coder names a single term, the other names both (B)
_classes.genuine: the coders name different things as wrong, or one names nothing

swap.F-165: the query: practice judged (the harvest set it made), reader held (the search string)
swap.F-169: the verifier: practice held (the check), reader judged (its first run)
swap.F-170: the stretched norm / the verdict passing V01
swap.F-172: draw.py's format comparison: practice held (the admission check), reader judged (the code against the rule)
swap.F-176: perceive.py B's drawing: practice held (the tool and its norm), reader judged (the drawing against the norm)
swap.F-179: the check for E4: practice held, reader judged (new check code)

genuine.F-177: practice: the night's call of the instrument; reader: the instrument itself (R)
genuine.F-192: practice: the form gave way (R); reader: neither (X)

swap.F-170: the norm / the verdict, as for A
swap.F-190: the copied renderer: practice judged, reader held (the renderer carrying the registered defect)
